svg.title: Where Out-of-Network Payments Land Before and After IDR
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-oon-payment-bands; chapter number: 4; title: Where Out-of-Network Payments Land Before and After IDR; subtitle: Payment bands as a share of billed charges; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: 0% to 100% of billed charges; buckets: label: Well-paid OON half; low: 60; high: 100; notes: Audits show half of OON payments land at 60-100% of charges.; label: Low-paid target half; low: 15; high: 17; notes: The other half pays 15-17% of charges and is the target population.; label: Post-IDR recovery target; low: 45; high: 55; notes: Filers push the low-paid half toward 45-55% of charges.; label: Ineligible disputes; low: 0; high: 0; notes: 1 in 5 disputes is thrown out as ineligible, yielding zero recovery.; caption: Money in federal IDR is won or lost at the screen, so eligibility checks precede the push from 15-17% toward 45-55% of charges.; assumptions note: Bands come from audit splits and filer targets; separately, Staffingly reports an 88% win rate with awards averaging 450% of QPA.; note: Attributed to Adam Cartabiano on Ryan Downs (7lqb5ev54mA) and Staffingly, Inc (ASHyX7v13Eo).
